name: Demolition Expert (Combat)
body:
You are better at destroying than you are at creating them.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (engineering) 1 rank, Power Attack

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 competence bonus to Strength checks against Break DCs to break or burst an item, and double bonuses you gain from portable rams and crowbars. Additionally, you gain an additional +2 bonus to damage when attacking objects directly.
